function.name: x_engagement_bot
function.description: Scrapes the X timeline or posts a reply to a specific tweet.

action.description: 'scrape' to read timeline, 'reply' to post a comment.

target_url.description: The URL of the tweet to reply to (required if action is 'reply').

reply_text.description: The AI-generated text to post (required if action is 'reply').
